name: Language Icons
project_description:
This module provides icons for language links, both for the Language switcher block and (optionally) for node links.

 The default icons provided are PNG images with a fixed height of 12 pixels and a variable width per the official dimension of the respective flag. However this module can handle other image types and sizes too. More language icons and new full collections of icons are welcome - please see [#319966] if you wish to get yours included in the standard distribution.

 Looking for active maintainers 
 This module is looking for active maintainers. Feel free to offer maintainership and show your references in issues.
